description: Source code implementing media metrics reporting functions related to DRM and media metrics, including functions for reporting DRM events, managing base64 decoding, and logging metrics via statsd.

methods.name: statsd_mediadrm
methods.description: Reports media DRM metrics, including vendor, description, and serialized metrics, to statsd.

methods.name: statsd_drmmanager
methods.description: Reports DRM manager API usage metrics, including method counts and plugin info, to statsd.

methods.name: base64DecodeNoPad
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded string without padding, used internally for processing serialized metrics.

methods.name: statsd_mediadrm_puller
methods.description: Pulls and reports detailed media DRM activity info, including vendor and description, via statsd.

methods.name: statsd_mediadrm_created
methods.description: Logs creation of a media DRM object with UUID and scheme information.

methods.name: statsd_mediadrm_session_opened
methods.description: Logs opening of a DRM session with security levels and object nonce.

methods.name: statsd_mediadrm_errored
methods.description: Logs DRM error events with detailed error codes and context.
